Source: In 2020, research showed that people who use water from the Nyanza Gulf in Lake Victoria take in a high level of toxins, or poisonous chemicals, even after they clean the water.

Zulu: Ngo-2020, ucwaningo lwabonisa ukuthi abantu abasebenzisa amanzi eNyanza Gulf eLake Victoria baphuza ubuthi obuphezulu, noma amakhemikhali anobuthi, ngisho nangemva kokuhlanza amanzi.
Hausa: A cikin shekarar 2020, bincike ya nuna cewa mutanen da ke amfani da ruwa daga Tekun Nyanza a Tafkin Victoria suna shan guba mai yawa, ko sinadarai masu guba, ko da bayan sun tsaftace ruwan.
Northern Sotho: Ka 2020, dinyakišišo di laeditše gore batho bao ba šomišago meetse a Kalofo ya Nyanza go Lake Victoria ba nwa dikelo tša godimo tša mepholo, goba dikhemikhale tše di nago le mpholo, le ka morago ga go hlwekiša meetse.

Source: Lake Victoria is filled with cyanobacteria, which are bacteria that live in the water and make their own food.
Luganda: Ennyanja Nalubaale ejjuddemu cyanobacteria, era na bakitiiriya ezo zibeera mu mazzi era zeekolera emmere yaazo.
Yoruba: Àwọn kòkòrò sàyánò ló kún inú omi Adágún Victoria, tí wọ́n jẹ́ àwọn kòkòrò tí wọ́n ń gbé inú omi tí wọ́n sì máa ń pèsè oúnjẹ fún ara wọn.
Zulu: I-Chibi i-Victoria ligcwele ama-cyanobacteria, okungamagciwane ahlala emanzini futhi azenzela ukudla kwawo.

Source: The researchers wanted to find out how much microcystins are in Lake Victoria, and how much of it is being ingested by the community.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baayagala okuzuula obungi bwa microcystins mu Nnyanja Nalubaale, n’okumanya obungi bw’obutwa abantu bwe banywa.

Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go tseba gore ke dimaekhrosisthini tše kae tše di lego go Lake Victoria, le gore ke tše kae tšeo di nwewago ke badudi.

Source: Most of the community filters, boils or adds chlorine to the water before using it, but researchers wanted to see if the microcystins are still present after cleaning.
Luganda: Abantu abasinga mu kitundu ekyo basengejja, bafumba oba bateekamu kuloliini mu mazzi nga tebannagakozsa, naye abanoonyereza baayagala okulaba oba nga microcystins ziba zikyalimu ng’amazzi gamaze okulongoosebwa.

Source: They collected water from 6 beaches along the Nyanza Gulf in Lake Victoria, and 127 household water samples along those beaches, between May and October, 2015.
Luganda: Baakuŋŋaanya amazi okuva ku bbiici 6 eziri ku kyondo kya Nyanza Gulf mu Nnyanja Nalubaale, ne bafuna ne sampolo z’amazzi okuva mu maka 127 galiraanye bbiici ezo, wakati w’Ogwokutaanu n’Ogwomukaaga, 2015.

Amharic: በሜይ እና በኦክቶበር 2015 መካከል በቪክቶሪያ ሐይቅ ውስጥ በኒያንዛ ባህረ ሰላጤ አካባቢ ከ6 የውሃ ዳርቻዎች ውሃን ሰብስበዋል ፤ እንዲሁም በእነዚሁ የውሃ ዳርቻ አካባቢዎች ባሉ ቤቶች 127 የውሃ ናሙናዎችን ወስደዋል፡፡

Source: They checked if microcystins were present, and then calculated how much of the poisonous chemical the communities might be ingesting.
Luganda: Baakebera okulaba oba nga microcystins zikyalimu, era ne babaza obungi bw’ebirungo by’obutwa abantu b’omu kitundu ekyo bwe bayinza okuba nga bayingiza mu mibiri gyabwe.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wò bóyá àwọn oró tí àwọn kòkòrò sàyánò tí wọ́n máa ń gbé inú omi máa ń bí ṣì wà níbẹ̀, lẹ́yìn èyí, wọ́n ṣe ìṣirò bí kẹ́míkáàlì tó ní oró tí ó ń wọ inú àwọn ará àgbègbè náà ṣe tó.
Zulu: Babheke ukuthi akhona yini ama-microcystin, base bebala ukuthi imiphakathi idla amakhemikhali anobuthi angakanani.
Hausa: Sun bincika ko ƙwayoyin halittar gansakuka suna nan, sannan suka ƙididdige yawan gubar sinadarai da al'ummomin za su iya sha.
Northern Sotho: Ba lekotše ge e ba a na le dimaekhrosisthini, gomme ba hlakantšha gore badudi ba ka be ba enwa dikhemikhale tše kaakang tše di nago le mpholo.
Amharic: ማይክሮሲስቲኖች መኖራቸውን ካጣሩ በኋላ የማህበረሰቡ አባላት ምን ያህል መርዛማ ኬሚካሎችን ወደሰውነታቸው እያስገቡ እንደሆነ አስልተዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers also used surveys to find out how households treat, or clean, their water.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu, abanoonyereza baakozesa okulondoba okusobola okuzuula engeri amaka gye galongoosa, oba okuyonja amazzi gaago.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣewádìí yìí tún ṣe àmúlò àwọn ìbéèrè ìwádìí láti mọ bí àwọn ilé kọ̀ọ̀kan ṣe ń ṣe ìtọ́jú àti bí wọ́n ṣe ń jẹ́ kí omi wọ́n mọ́.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde basebenzisa inhlolovo ukuthola ukuthi imindeni iwaphatha kanjani, noma ahlanze, amanzi ayo.
Hausa: Masu binciken kuma sun yi amfani da bincike don gano yadda gidaje ke bi, ko tsaftace ruwansu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šomišitše le diphatišišo go utolla ka moo malapa a hlwekišago, goba a hlatswago, meetse a ona.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ ተመራማሪዎቹ ቤተሰቦች ውሃቸውን እንዴት እንደሚያክሙ እና እንደሚያጣሩ ለማወቅ የዳሰሳ ጥናቶችን ተጠቅመዋል፡፡

Source: They noticed that more than 80% of all the water samples contained microcystins, but beach water was more toxic than household water.
Luganda: Baakiraba nti ebitundu ebisukka mu 80% ebya sampolo z’amazzi byalimu microcystins, naye amazzi g’oku bbiici gaalimu obutwa okusinga ago ag’omu maka.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àkíyèsí pé àwọnoró tí àwọn kòkòrò sàyánò tí wọ́n máa ń gbé inú omi máa ń bí wà nínú oríṣiríṣi omi tí wọ́n ṣiṣẹ́ lé lórí tí ó sì ju 80% lọ, ṣùgbọ́n oró tí ó wà nínú omi etí òkun pọ̀ ju omi ilé lọ.
Zulu: Baqaphela ukuthi ngaphezu kwe-80% yawo wonke amasampula amanzi aqukethe ama-microcystins, kodwa amanzi ogwini ayenobuthi kakhulu kunamanzi asekhaya.
Hausa: Sun lura cewa fiye da kashi 80% na duk samfuran ruwa sun ƙunshi ƙwayoyin halittar gansakuka, amma ruwan bakin teku ya fi guba fiye da ruwan gida.
Northern Sotho: Ba lemogile gore go feta 80% tša disampole ka moka tša meetse di be di na le dimaekhrosisthini, eupša meetse a lebopong a be a le kotsi kudu go feta meetse a ka malapeng.
Amharic: ከ80% በላይ የሚሆኑት ሁሉም የውሃ ናሙናዎች ማይክሮሲስቲኖችን እንደሚይዙ አስተውለዋል፤ ነገር ግን የውሃ ዳርቻ ውሃ ከቤት ውስጥ ውሃ የበለጠ መርዛማ ነው፡፡

Source: Most people did treat their water before using it by filtering out as much dirt as possible.
Luganda: Abantu abasinga baalongoosanga amazzi gaabwe nga tebannagakozesa nga bagasengejja okuggyamu obukyafu bwonna nga bwe baasobolanga.
Yoruba: Púpọ̀ lára àwọn èèyàn náà máa ń ṣe ìtọ́jú omi wọn nípa yíyọ́ gbogbo àwọn ìdọ̀tí tí wọ́n bá lè rí yọ́ nínú ẹ̀ kí wọ́n tó lò ó.
Zulu: Abantu abaningi babewageza amanzi abo ngaphambi kokuba bawasebenzise ngokuhlunga ukungcola okuningi ngangokunokwenzeka.
Hausa: Yawancin mutane suna tsaftace ruwansu ta hanyar tace dauɗa sosai kafin amfani da shi.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja batho ba hlwekišitše meetse a bona pele ba a šomiša ka go a sekiša go tloša tšhila yeo e ka bago e le gona.
Amharic: ብዙ ሰዎች በተቻለ መጠን ቆሻሻን አጣርተው በማውጣት ውሃቸውን ከመጠቀማቸው በፊት አክመውታል፡፡

Source: Unfortunately, filtering does not get rid of all microcystins, and so the community could be taking in 4 times more poisonous chemicals than they should, said researchers.
Luganda: Ebyembi, abanoonyereza baagamba nti okusengejja tekuggyaamu microcystins zonna, kale nno abantu abo bayinza okuba nga bayingiza mu mibiri gyabwe ebirungo by’obutwa bya mirundi 4 okusinga nga bwe kyandibadde.
Yoruba: Ó ṣeni láànú pé yíyọ omi náà kìí pa gbogbo oró tí àwọn kòkòrò sàyánò tí wọ́n máa ń gbé inú omi máa ń bí àti pé àwọn àgbègbè yìí lè máa muàwọn kẹ́míkáàlì tí wọ́n ní oró náà ní ìlọ́po mẹ́rin ju bí ó ṣe yẹ lọ, jẹ́ ohun tí àwọn àṣewádìí sọ.
Zulu: Ngeshwa, ukuhlunga akuwasusi wonke ama-microcystin, ngakho-ke umphakathi ungase uphuze amakhemikhali anobuthi ngokuphindwe izikhathi ezi-4 kunalokho okufanele, kusho abacwaningi.
Hausa: Abin baƙin ciki, tacewa ba ya kawar da duk ƙwayoyin halittar gansakuka, don haka, al'umma na iya shan sinadarai masu guba sau 4 fiye da yadda ya kamata, in ji masu bincike.
Northern Sotho: Ka madimabe, go sekiša meetse ga go hlokole dimaekhrosisthini ka moka, le gona banyakišiši ba boletše gore badudi ba ka ba ba enwa meetse makga a go feta a 4 a dikhemikhale tša mpholo o kotsi kudu go feta ka moo go swanetšego.
Amharic: በሚያሳዝን ሁኔታ ማጣራት ሁሉንም ማይክሮሲስቲኖች አያስወግድም፤ ስለዚህ የማህበረሰቡ አባላት መውሰድ ከሚገባቸው 4 እጥፍ የበለጠ መርዛማ ኬሚካሎችን ሊወስዱ እንደሚችሉ ተመራማሪዎቹ ተናግረዋል፡፡

Source: Before this study, researchers knew that Lake Victoria is home to cyanobacteria, however its toxicity on the surrounding communities was uncertain.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno nga tekunnakolebwa, abanoonyereza baali bamanyi nti Ennyanja Nalubaale ebeeramu cyanobacteria, wabula, obutwa obulimu mu bitundu ebyetooloddewo bwali tebumanyiddwa.
Yoruba: Kí iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí tó bẹ̀rẹ̀, àwọn àṣewádìí mọ̀ pé omi Adágún Victoria jẹ́ ilé fún àwọn kòkòrò sàyánò, ṣùgbọ́n oró ẹ̀ lórí àwọn àgbègbè tí ó yi ká jẹ́ ohun tí a ò mọ̀.
Zulu: Ngaphambi kwalolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babazi ukuthi iLake Victoria iyikhaya le-cyanobacteria, nokho ubuthi bayo emiphakathini ezungezile babungaqiniseki.
Hausa: Kafin wannan binciken, masu bincike sun san cewa Tafkin Victoria gida ne ga bakteriyar gansakuka, duk da haka babu tabbacin gubarsa a kan al'ummomin da ke kewaye.
Northern Sotho: Pele ga dinyakišišo tše, banyakišiši ba tsebile gore Lake Victoria ke legae la disianopaktheria, le ge go le bjalo, bokotsi bja yona go badudi ba tikologo bo be bo sa lemogwe gabotse.
Amharic: ከዚህ ጥናት በፊት ተመራማሪዎቹ የቪክቶሪያ ሐይቅ ለሲያኖባክቴሪያ መኖሪያ ቤት እንደሆነ ያውቃሉ፤ ነገር ግን በአካባቢው ባሉ ማህበረሰቦች ላይ ያለው መርዛማነት ግን በግልጽ አይታወቅም ነበር፡፡

Source: This study clearly shows that indeed people are consuming high amounts of the toxins in the water, and that filtering or boiling doesn’t get rid of these toxins.
Luganda: Kale nno, okunoonyereza kuno kulaga bulungi nti ddala abantu banywa obutwa buyitirivu mu mazzi, era nti okusengejja oba okufumba tekuyamba kuggyamu butwa obwo.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí fi hàn gedegbe pé lóòótọ́ àwọn èèyàn ń mu oró púpọ̀ nínú omi yìí àti pé yíyọ́ tàbí gbígbé omi náà kaná ò kí ń pa oró inú omi náà.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi ngempela abantu badla inqwaba yobuthi obusemanzini, nokuthi ukusefa noma ukubilisa akubuqedi lobu buthi.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya nuna ƙarara cewa lallai mutane suna shan guba mai yawa a cikin ruwa, kuma tacewa ko tafasawa ba ya kawar da waɗannan gubar.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di tloga di laetša gore ka nnete batho ba nwa dikelo tša godimo tša mepholo ka meetseng, le gore go sekišwa goba go bedišwa ga meetse ga go bolaye mepholo ye.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት ሰዎች በእርግጥም ውሃ ውስጥ የሚገኙ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያላቸውን መርዞች ወደሰውነታቸው እያስገቡ እንደሆነ በግልጽ ያሳያል፤ እነዚህንም መርዞች ማጣራትም ሆነ ማፍላት አያስወግዳቸውም፡፡

Source: The scientists recommended that the government should educate and spread awareness to the surrounding communities about the dangers of drinking this contaminated water.
Luganda: Bannassaayansi basemba nti gavumenti esaana esomese abantu abeetoolodde ekitundu kino era ebamanyise ku kabi akali mu kunywa amazzi agalimu obutwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ ìjìnlẹ̀ sáyẹ́nsì sọ pé kí ìjọba ṣe ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àti ìlanilọ́yẹ̀ fún àwọn àgbègbè tó yí wọn ká lórí ewu mímu omi tí kò dára yìí.
Zulu: Ososayensi baphakamise ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele afundise futhi asabalalise imiphakathi ezungezile ngobungozi bokuphuza la manzi angcolile.
Hausa: Masana kimiyya sun ba da shawarar cewa ya kamata gwamnati ta wayar da kan al'ummomin da ke kewaye dangane da illolin shan wannan gurbataccen ruwa.
Northern Sotho: Ditsebi tša mahlale di šišintše gore mmušo o swanetše go ruta le go phatlalatša temošo go badudi ba tikologo mabapi le dikotsi tša go nwa meetse ao a tšhilafaditšwego.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶቹ ይህን የተበከለ ውሃ በመጠጣት ስለሚከሰቱ አደጋዎች መንግስት በአካባቢው ያሉ ማህበረሰቦችን ማስተማር እና ግንዛቤን ማስፋፋት እንዳለበት ይመክራሉ፡፡

Source: The authors of this paper were from Kenya.
Luganda: Abawandiisi b’olupapula luno baali bava mu Kenya.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí wá láti Kenya.
Zulu: Ababhali baleli phepha bebephuma eKenya.
Hausa: Mawallafan wannan takarda ‘yan ƙasar Kenya ne.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba sengwalwa se ba be ba etšwa Kenya.
Amharic: የዚህ ጥናታዊ ወረቀት ጸሃፊዎች ከኬኒያ ነበሩ፡፡
